name: attention
notes: HARDWARE GESTURE TABLE, whole-arm revision. Positions are OFFSETS from whatever pose the arm is resting in. Authorized 2026-08-30 by the user at the arm ('you can move the whole arm but do it slow and dont hit anything') after the earlier gripper-only version read as the arm doing nothing. LOOKS LIKE: the arm turns its base toward the operator, lifts on joint3 with a small shoulder set on joint2, cocks the wrist over, and gives one clamp of the jaws before settling back. joint2 stays at 10 deg against its ~105 deg base-collision trap; joint3 does the lifting, which yam.arm records as self-collision-free from home. Peak 5.7 deg/s, well under the 15 deg/s slow ceiling; gripper 11.1 %/s under its 12 %/s limit.

waypoints.label: turn to operator, lift, cock wrist
